reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Activation grants paid curriculum entitlement to a named person and is the most expensive act in this domain. The agent is capped at answering questions about blockers from approved knowledge; even shadow mode is not proposed, because a shadow activation list invites a one-click bulk apply.

The module is pure and report-only by deliberate design. A supervised production pilot of the report is reachable; raising the agent to an action level would mean writing the pointer, which the module's own header forbids.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Internship acceptance is always a human decision. The agent may reach shadow mode, producing a would-be posture compared against the human outcome, and no further: R6 and above would imply a pilot in which the agent acts, and there is no action here it is permitted to take.

Placing a real call to a real applicant is an external side effect on a person holding two separate consents. Sandbox exercise is legitimate; production dialling is not proposed at any level in this task.

Nothing exists. The write audit on state transitions is real, but no READ audit over the document or transcript routes was found, so there is no evidence to promote on and definition work is the only justifiable level.

The assessment is advisory by construction and the state machine refuses its output as a transition input. Shadow comparison against decisions Dhee actually made is the highest useful level; anything above it would imply the assessment acts, which the design forbids.

The writer is the gate for every admission outcome. An agent may exercise it against sandbox fixtures, but production writes to internship_applications.state would let an agent move a real applicant, so no level above R4 is proposed.

Monitoring reads and reports and writes nothing to a person's record, so a separately approved supervised production pilot is reachable. It stays below action automation because the actions that follow a bad pace reading, nudging and exiting, are separate capabilities with their own ceilings.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Nothing is built and the join between the two systems does not exist. A handoff transfers accountability for a person, which is a human act, so the agent is capped at describing the gap until Dhee defines the contract.
Read-only over an existing subsystem the internship domain is instructed not to change, so a separately approved supervised production pilot of the report is the reasonable ceiling.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: The move touches entitlement and the enrollment identity that roughly twenty route files read. A wrong move shows a student a complete, coherent, wrong portal with nothing logged, which is why the agent is capped at explaining the model rather than operating it.

Reporting reads and aggregates and writes nothing to a person's record, so a separately approved supervised production pilot is reachable. The weekly report names individuals and is sent to staff, so the sending half would need its own authorized action class before any higher level.

Nothing is built, so no evidence exists for any level. A manager-facing warning is low blast radius, but the comp data model location is unknown and the lead time is unset, so shadow mode is the honest ceiling until both are resolved.

The owner named DA work transitioning to AI as a source of proposed responsibilities, but no specific internship DA deliverable was identified, so there is nothing to validate and nothing to measure. R0 definition work with at most R2 question-answering is the honest ceiling.

The computation is pure, deterministic and read-only, so a separately approved supervised production pilot is reachable on evidence. It never writes and never decides, which is what keeps it below the action-automation levels.

It writes a task, not a change to a person, and already runs deterministically on a cron. A separately approved supervised production pilot under the new employee is reachable, but the shared runDomainFlag shape means the blast radius of a change reaches six sibling directors, so no higher level is proposed.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: The dry run is a zero-write sandbox-safe operation, which is exactly R4 work. Commit changes the lifecycle state of real people in bulk, which is the highest-blast-radius write in the domain and stays with a human.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Generation is stateful multi-step sandbox work the pipeline already supports, so R4 fits the drafting half. Publication puts a plan in front of a named intern and is reserved to the reviewer, so no level above R4 is proposed.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Removing a person from the programme is irreversible in practice and the repo already carries two documented false positives on named interns. The agent may reach shadow mode on the escalation list; the exit act stays with a human permanently.

Assembly is a pure projection with no writes, so a separately approved supervised production pilot is reachable. It stays below action automation because everything that makes the portfolio public is the separate publication capability.

Nothing exists. The owner's candidate named project matching recommendations, and what the application actually has is project GENERATION plus a readiness gate, which is a different capability. Until Dhee says a catalog should exist, R0 definition work and at most R2 question-answering is all that can be justified.

Like the reminder capability, the sending half is an approved-template action class with a one-beat-per-day idempotency key, so R7 is reachable for that class alone once separately approved. R8 and R9 are not proposed, because handing a candidate onward is a human act that ends at recruiters.

Preparing a brief is safe and already deterministic. Posting the note speaks in a named human's voice through a token that acts as Ali, so shadow mode is the ceiling until an agent-attributed write path exists.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: This is the governance prerequisite for every other capability here. Granting or changing a role is an authorization change, which no agent may make at any level, so the ceiling is explaining the chain and its gap.
Rendering a package in sandbox is safe and testable. Generating a real document attaches a legal-looking artifact to a named person, so production generation is not proposed here.

The checklist is a pure read-and-resolve over evidence another capability writes. It changes nothing, so a separately approved supervised production pilot of the reporting view is reachable on measured evidence.

Reading and reporting the unpaid set is safe. Expiring an application withdraws a real person's place, so the ceiling is shadow mode and the expiry act stays with the reviewer or the existing system edge.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Publication makes a named person's work public under their own slug. The agent may reach shadow mode on the readiness score and the queue ordering; approval and visibility stay with a career reviewer permanently.
Pure read-and-derive with no writes and no external side effects, so a separately approved supervised production pilot of the readiness report is reachable on measured evidence.

The queue is the widest applicant-PII read surface in the domain and mgmtRoles.ts calls it a materially wider grant than editing curriculum. Production agent access is not proposed and the ceiling stays at sandbox stateful work.

This is the owner's worked example: an internship agent may eventually send approved routine document reminders while internship acceptance remains a human decision. R7 automates only that explicitly authorized action class, bounded to the fixed template allowlist and the day-scoped idempotency key. R8 and R9 are not proposed, because a handoff or an ownership claim would widen the action class beyond reminders.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Verification is the gate between a submitted file and a granted entitlement, and the state machine admits no automated actor. Shadow completeness checks are the highest useful level; the verification act is reserved to a human permanently.

The underlying genome exists and can be read in sandbox, so R4 analysis work is justifiable. Production use is not, because the target profile the gap is measured against does not exist and a gap reported without it would be a number about a person with no referent.

The data is known-unreliable and the product has already decided not to render it. Until a denominator exists, nothing above sandbox analysis can be justified, because a production attendance report would be a number nobody can defend.
Authoring and validating question sets is sandbox-safe work. Writing an applicant's own answers in production is the applicant's act, not the agent's, so R4 is the ceiling.

authority_rule.rule: A capability approved above autonomy:R2 with no granted tools is forced back down to autonomy:R2, with the reason no_tool_grants. Tool grants are the throttle.
authority_rule.note: When this binds nothing, say so in words. It means no capability in this domain has been approved above autonomy:R2 yet, not that the rule is absent or that the panel failed.

governance.disclosure: A filed request grants nothing. Status is what a named human decided, and a pending row means nobody has decided yet.

verification.disclosure: A criterion counts as passing when it is marked in `.colaberry/progress.json` in this repository. The verifier reads that file on every sync and records what it found. A story showing 0 of N is not a rejection: nothing has been claimed yet.
